cards.title: SpaceX Officially Closes Cursor Acquisition
cards.body: AI coding startup Cursor is now officially part of SpaceX. The acquisition marks SpaceX's expansion into AI development tools.

cards.title: Google Lets Users Remove AI Watermarks
cards.body: Google now allows removal of visible watermarks from AI-generated images. Invisible benchmarks remain for file identification purposes.

cards.title: Meta Releases Open-Weight Glimmer Model
cards.body: Meta released Glimmer, an open-weight AI model anyone can download and run locally. This contrasts with Muse Spark, Meta's more powerful proprietary model.

cards.title: Kog Optimizes GPU Inference for Agents
cards.body: French startup Kog challenges the notion that GPUs are poorly suited for agentic workflows. The company aims to squeeze more inference efficiency from GPU hardware.

cards.title: Natural Gas Prices May Spike for Data Centers
cards.body: New forecasts suggest natural gas prices could triple in parts of the U.S. This could burden hyperscalers with massive bills for AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Writer Launches Cost-Effective AI Model
cards.body: Writer introduced a new AI model built as a post-training variant of GLM-5.2. The system offers deployment-ready capabilities at significantly lower costs.

cards.title: Databricks Raises $5B at $190B Valuation
cards.body: Databricks closed a $5 billion funding round, exceeding initial $1B target due to investor demand. The company now values at $190 billion.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches 'Ultrafast' GPT-5.6 Sol Mode
cards.body: OpenAI introduced Ultrafast, a new mode enabling GPT-5.6 Sol to run 14x faster. The preview targets enterprise users seeking higher performance.

cards.title: IBM Partners with OpenAI on Enterprise AI
cards.body: IBM plans to train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI technologies. The partnership bolsters IBM's enterprise AI offerings.

cards.title: Anthropic AI Agents Start Turf Wars
cards.body: Anthropic researchers discovered AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate unexpectedly when competing on the same task. The findings raise questions about multi-agent safety testing.

cards.title: OpenAI Hires New Chief Revenue Officer
cards.body: OpenAI replaced CRO Denise Dresser after nine months, hiring Dali Rajic from Wiz. Rajic becomes the frontier lab's new top sales executive.

cards.title: Microsoft Consolidates Copilot, Cuts Features
cards.body: Microsoft merged consumer and business Copilot apps while dropping podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and Mico character. The move simplifies the product line.

cards.title: Nvidia's $500B Plan Sustains GPU Values
cards.body: Nvidia launched a plan to maintain GPU values by involving financiers in AI buildouts. The strategy helps prevent depreciation of aging GPUs.

cards.title: Apple Negotiates Publisher News Payments
cards.body: Apple is in talks to pay publishers for current news access in Siri. The tech giant has considered a nine-figure budget for payments.

cards.title: Anthropic Watermarks Draw User Backlash
cards.body: Some Claude users complained on social media about Anthropic's new watermarking system. Users worry the watermarks will flag workplace and classroom usage.

cards.title: Amazon Trains on Twitch Content by Default
cards.body: Amazon will use Twitch streamers' content for AI training unless creators opt out. Twitch's CPO admitted an opt-in approach would see zero adoption.

cards.title: Cognition Targets $40B Valuation Round
cards.body: AI coding startup Cognition is reportedly in talks for a mega funding round. The company seeks a $40 billion valuation just months after raising $1 billion.

cards.title: AI Pioneers Debate Openness and Safety
cards.body: Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng debated AI regulation and open-source access. The discussion covered America's competitive position against China's AI advances.

cards.title: Thrive Holdings Raises $2B for Enterprise AI
cards.body: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings closed a $2 billion funding round at $12 billion valuation. Investors include SoftBank, D1 Capital Partners, and Altimeter Capital.

cards.title: SpaceX officially closes Cursor acquisition
cards.body: AI coding startup Cursor is now officially part of SpaceX. The acquisition marks another major player entering the AI infrastructure space.

cards.title: Google lets users remove AI watermarks
cards.body: Users can now disable visible watermarks on Google AI-generated content. Invisible benchmarks remain to identify AI-generated files.

cards.title: Meta releases open-weight Glimmer AI model
cards.body: Meta released Glimmer, an open-weight AI model anyone can download and run locally. This contrasts with Muse Spark, Meta's more powerful proprietary model behind APIs.

cards.title: Kog optimizes GPU inference for AI agents
cards.body: French startup Kog challenges the belief that GPUs are poorly suited for agentic workflows. The company aims to squeeze more efficiency from GPU-based AI inference.

cards.title: Writer launches new cost-efficient AI model
cards.body: Writer introduced a new AI model built on Z.ai's open-source GLM-5.2. The system promises deployment-ready capabilities at significantly lower token costs.

cards.title: Databricks raises $5B at $190B valuation
cards.body: Databricks secured $5 billion in funding at a $190 billion valuation, exceeding its initial $1 billion target. CEO Ali Ghodsi cited high investor demand and AI infrastructure costs.

cards.title: OpenAI launches Ultrafast GPT-5.6 Sol mode
cards.body: OpenAI previewed a sped-up version of GPT-5.6 Sol running 14x faster. The new mode targets enterprise users seeking improved performance.

cards.title: IBM partners with OpenAI for enterprise AI
cards.body: IBM will train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI technologies. The partnership aims to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.

cards.title: Anthropic studies AI agents in conflict
cards.body: Anthropic researchers found AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate unexpectedly. The findings raise questions about multi-agent AI safety testing.

cards.title: Microsoft simplifies Copilot by merging apps
cards.body: Microsoft combined consumer and business Copilot apps into a unified platform. The company dropped AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, and Deep Research features.

cards.title: Nvidia plans $500B strategy for aging GPUs
cards.body: Nvidia aims to maintain GPU value through new financial partnerships for AI buildouts. The plan targets lenders to sustain demand for compute infrastructure.

cards.title: Anthropic watermarks raise detection concerns
cards.body: Anthropic's new watermarking system flags Claude usage in professional and academic settings. Some users worry the watermarks will expose unauthorized tool use.

cards.title: Amazon trains AI on Twitch content by default
cards.body: Amazon will use Twitch streamers' content for AI training unless users opt out. Twitch CPO acknowledged that opt-in would result in minimal participation.

cards.title: Cognition raises at $40B valuation
cards.body: AI coding startup Cognition is reportedly in talks for another mega funding round. The valuation jump comes months after raising $1 billion at $26 billion.

cards.title: Three AI pioneers debate open source models
cards.body: Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng discussed AI regulation and open access at Ai4. The experts debated how America can compete as China advances.

cards.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raises $2B
cards.body: Thrive Holdings secured $2 billion at a $12 billion valuation for enterprise AI. SoftBank, D1 Capital, and Altimeter Capital led the funding round.

cards.title: How kids feel about AI, in their own words
cards.body: MIT Technology Review interviewed tweens about their views on artificial intelligence. Children shared both creative and concerning ways they encounter AI daily.

cards.title: Man injects prompts in court filings against AI
cards.body: A defendant attempted to manipulate court AI systems by embedding prompts in legal filings. The tactic reflects growing concerns about AI in legal proceedings.

cards.title: OpenAI and Anthropic in AI pricing war
cards.body: OpenAI and Anthropic are competing aggressively on AI model pricing. Chinese AI rivals are simultaneously gaining competitive ground.
